roots.title: The published tracker issue for this map
roots.fix: Re-render with `python3 maintainer/backlog.py render` and edit #110's body after each root closes.

roots.title: Provisioned environments drift from the pinned specification
roots.fix: Pin what setup_env.py installs (kagglesdk now; derive from requirements.txt as the root fix), verify the micromamba artifact, and guard every optional import.

evidence.108: scripts/setup_env.py:77 bare kagglesdk; skills/paper-ingestion/scripts/extract_pdf.py:543 unguarded marker import

roots.proof: fix/env-provisioning (#108, tests/test_env_pins.py); PR #95 (#57) accepted; #58 needs a decision

roots.title: State the server measures is not pushed to the dashboard
roots.fix: Publish health_update whenever a measurement is taken; refetch /api/state on SSE reconnect.
roots.proof: PR #114 closed #100; #83 closed as superseded by command center SSE and PR #142

roots.title: Untrusted values reach argv where they can act as options
roots.fix: End options with -- (or reject a leading -) before every value-bearing positional, quote remote command text once, and make dry-run the default the guard assumes.
roots.proof: PR #98 closes #82; fix/argv-boundaries closes #81, refs #56 #59

roots.title: The engine's crash recorder writes defects for invalid input, outside the gated targets
roots.fix: Classify unreadable input as a refusal, and record a crash only through resolve_target/validate_name into an existing product dir.
roots.proof: fix/engine-defect-recorder closes #88, refs #67 (--session validation open)

roots.title: adopt crashes on an undefined WORKSPACE
roots.fix: Resolve WORKSPACE through impl_layout; isolated adopt regression.
roots.proof: fix/adopt-nameerror refs #52 (re-seal adopt-same-target open)

roots.title: Setup and upgrade overwrite what the user owns
roots.fix: Replace only symlinks the setup created; upgrade compares to the recorded hash and writes atomically.
roots.proof: fix/user-file-preservation closes #63; #65 open

roots.title: A CLI converts its module URL by hand
roots.fix: Use fileURLToPath from node:url in cli.mjs.
roots.proof: commit c01371c9 closes #76 using fileURLToPath

roots.title: Agent instructions name flags the CLI does not have
roots.fix: Derive the ingestion agent's commands from the CLI contract and guard them with a test.
roots.proof: fix/agent-cli-drift refs #70 (roster count and redactor contract open)

roots.title: Generated JSON is indexed before it is validated
roots.fix: Validate draft envelopes at the paper_cli boundary before paper_write reads them.
roots.proof: closes #71 with envelope validation and fence stripping

roots.title: Acceptance evidence is weaker than what it is read as
roots.fix: Decide the evidence contracts: executed invariants, byte-level revision identity, blocking undecidable findings.

roots.title: Agents hold the authority the human gates depend on
roots.fix: Threat-model decision: credential isolation, permission defaults, approvals bound to authority the agent lacks.

roots.title: CI does not lint, type-check or measure coverage
roots.fix: Choose the gates and add them in slices.

roots.title: Project mutations are coordinated only in-process; two YAML parsers
roots.fix: One cross-process lock and one papersmith.yaml parser.

roots.title: Monolithic engine, tests, skills and README
roots.fix: Split by command module; progressive disclosure for skills and docs; behavioral evals.

roots.title: Multi-account Kaggle scheduling vs service policy
roots.fix: Record a policy review; the one-account-per-person attestation exists (core/team.py:39).
roots.proof: COLAB_ATTESTATION in core/team.py:39, PR #112 and test_no_personal_context_dependency.py closes #77

roots.title: OCR device selection on Intel Macs
roots.fix: Decide whether to pin CPU when MPS is unusable; surfacing OCR timeouts is part of ingestion-silent-loss.
roots.proof: closes #103 with Intel Mac MPS CPU fallback

roots.title: Describe extracted figures
roots.fix: Keyless, local pixelrag skill: deterministic figure facts plus the session agent's description, validated and stored beside the image (decision: keyless, like paper-ingestion).
roots.proof: tests/test_pixelrag.py; commit 7fa3f241; released in 0.78.0

roots.title: Under WSL the dashboard hands URLs to a launcher that opens a folder instead
roots.fix: Open URLs from WSL with wslview, else rundll32 url.dll,FileProtocolHandler; never explorer.exe, which opens Documents for a URL with a query string while reporting a launch.
roots.proof: tests/test_command_center_open_browser.py::OpenBrowserTests::test_wsl_falls_back_to_the_url_protocol_handler and ::test_wsl_never_hands_a_url_to_explorer (RED on main, GREEN on fix/wsl-url-launcher)

roots.title: Protocol hypotheses are buried and disclosures collapse on repaint
roots.fix: Show the protocol after launch warnings and retain open/closed disclosures by stable experiment and product keys.
roots.proof: test_experiments_disclosure_visibility.py: 6 RED/1 existing-behavior pass on main, 96 focused GREEN; real Chromium refresh, tab and language checks at desktop and narrow viewports

roots.title: Readers of proposal revisions and protocol headings disagree with Phase 4 and the shared convention
roots.fix: Make the slug optional in the revision pattern, cap tagged equations only, and read [exp:<id>] at any heading level in citations, experiments_view and discussion.
roots.proof: tests/test_sota_citations.py slugless/cap/heading-level tests, PR #157

roots.title: The header run selector shows full proposal file names
roots.fix: Label each option with its run id and keep the file name as value and tooltip.
roots.proof: ui/e2e/shipped/run-selector.spec.ts, PR #158

roots.title: SOTA citations are not tied to what their reference's abstract states
roots.fix: Require a verbatim abstract quote per citation and publish the reverse reference-to-idea map (citations_cli.py routes).
roots.proof: tests/test_sota_citations.py quote and routes tests, PR #162

roots.title: The reviewing judge is named after a venue
roots.fix: Rename the judge to judge-reviewer everywhere (step id, refusal code, i18n, agents, skills, docs).
roots.proof: PR #164; git grep -i neurips finds only test fixtures

roots.title: Tests that pass under the empty home and fail intermittently under the decoy home
roots.fix: Ask each identical request once per search (single-flight per cache key in journal_cli Http.get_json), so a first search's cached count no longer depends on thread timing.
roots.proof: tests/test_journal_finder.py::CacheTests::test_one_search_never_asks_the_same_request_twice; 16/16 concurrent runs; commit 1aeaaa38; released in 0.78.0

evidence.166: tests/test_journal_finder.py:1963 failed once under the decoy home on CI

roots.title: paper-writing tools lose or misplace work: stale overwrites, English-only parsers, missing verbs, a floor nobody enforced
roots.fix: --expect-digest compare-and-swap on substitute/write/humanize, reorder verb, multilingual discussion labels, \foreignlanguage exemption, single-section separate, stale-fact warnings, and a Python 3.11 floor guard in every skill CLI.
roots.proof: tests/test_paper_block_cas.py, test_paper_reorder.py, test_paper_declarations_stale.py, test_python_floor.py; independent verifier PASS on 5b772644; reviews acknowledged; released in 0.78.0

roots.title: Coherence, caption and figure checks existed only as agent judgement
roots.fix: paper_coherence.py advisory checks in verify (captions, overclaiming, claims-findings, not-performed, symbols, names) and figure-review measuring from the compiled document with width, whitespace, numeric-text advisories and figure provenance.
roots.proof: tests/test_paper_coherence.py, test_figure_review_measure.py, test_paper_figure_provenance.py; released in 0.78.0

roots.title: Run records did not name host, hardware or threads, and cross-host combinations went unflagged
roots.fix: runtime block in bootstrap.json, shard.json, the kit benchmark and timing.json; runtimeWarnings in parallelism estimate/plan and verify --shards.
roots.proof: tests/test_run_record_host.py, test_shard_runtime_warnings.py; released in 0.78.0

roots.title: Citations can rest on sources whose support is never checked
roots.fix: Done: bib build prefers published records and normalizes entities and types; verify warns on cited sources without title or abstract. Open: the opt-in cite-once policy and an auditor pass on claim/quote support, which need a maintainer decision.
roots.proof: tests/test_paper_bib_published.py, test_paper_verify_references.py; items 2, 4 and the visible warning released in 0.78.0
